# awesome-local-ai

> A curated list of AI tools that run entirely on local hardware without cloud dependencies or telemetry.

The project is a static list organized by categories such as inference runtimes, voice, and code assistants. It includes inclusion rules requiring verifiable provenance and strict local inference, with entries labeled by platform, license, and language.

## Docs

- [awesome-local-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/main/README.md): Inclusion rules and strict criteria for AI tools that run inference entirely on user-owned hardware.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Strict rule requiring inference on owned hardware without transmitting data off-device during normal use.
- [Inclusion rules](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#inclusion-rules): Requirements for local hardware execution, verifiable provenance, and installable artifacts, plus maintenance and removal policies.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#legend): Icons indicating operating systems, source availability, pricing, programming languages, and recent listing status.
- [Inference Runtimes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#inference-runtimes): Engines for running LLMs and neural networks locally, including llama.cpp, ExLlamaV3, and LM Studio.
- [Desktop Chat Apps](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#desktop-chat-apps): GUI applications wrapping local runtimes in chat interfaces, such as Anything LLM and Open WebUI.
- [Voice — Speech-to-Text](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#voice--speech-to-text): Offline speech-to-text tools like Buzz and faster-whisper for transcription and translation on local hardware.
- [Voice — Text-to-Speech](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#voice--text-to-speech): Local text-to-speech engines such as Piper, Kokoro, and Chatterbox for offline voice synthesis.
- [Image Generation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#image-generation): Local image generation interfaces including ComfyUI, Forge, and InvokeAI for diffusion model workflows.
- [Video Generation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#video-generation): Local video generation tools like ComfyUI with LTX Video and WanGP for consumer GPUs.
- [Code Assistants](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#code-assistants): Terminal, IDE, and desktop coding assistants running fully locally against Ollama, LM Studio, or llama.cpp.
- [Local Agents](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#local-agents): General-purpose local agents, planning modes, and memory systems for coding tasks using local models.
- [Vector Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#vector-databases): Open-source vector databases and similarity search libraries for local embedding storage and retrieval.
- [Embeddings](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#embeddings): BGE, fastembed, and Sentence Transformers for generating local text embeddings using CPU or GPU acceleration.
- [Training & Fine-tuning](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#training--fine-tuning): Frameworks and tools for fine-tuning diffusion models and LLMs locally on consumer or Apple hardware.
- [Local Search & RAG](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#local-search--rag): Self-hosted RAG pipelines, private API layers, and offline search engines for local AI applications.
- [Operating Systems Tuned for AI](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#operating-systems-tuned-for-ai): CachyOS and Pop!_OS, two Linux distributions tuned for local AI and GPU driver support.
- [Hardware-Specific Runtimes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#hardware-specific-runtimes): Runtimes for AMD, Apple, NVIDIA, Intel, and ROCm GPUs, including Lemonade, MLX LM, TensorRT-LLM, and OpenVINO.
- [Translation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#translation): Earshot AI, an iPhone app for on-device speech and text translation using a bundled HY model.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Links to related projects covering llms.txt tools, privacy AI, MCP servers, licenses, Linux distros, and ComfyUI workflows.
